risk_note: RV1 (packages/bridge-sdk, ops/risk-map.yaml since #120). H5 side of the JSBridge: isInApp, has() returning a capability handle that call() requires (compile-time has-before-call, TECH-28), on(), an in-memory h5_token manager (BR-ID-32: 10002 refetch, read_only scope refetch before writes, invalidate), conformance-only untyped invoke (App outside: 90001). Rule tests by Codex (red first in the container), implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in two rounds. Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 2 (10002 / h5_read_only only clear the cached token and reuse the in-flight fetch; interleaving tests added): pass, no findings | earlier: round 1 fail (S1: a 10002 refetch and a read_only refetch before a write could race and drop the in-flight fetch, giving two token fetches; fixed in round 2)

reviews.scope: independent read-only Claude subagent (second reviewer; the PR adds test/**, so RV2 evidence): pass, no S0/S1; S2 invalidate() lets a request already awaiting the in-flight token fetch send with the old token (auth.changed race) — follow-up; S3 event data passed through unfiltered, unchecked getH5Token result, has() with a union type, on() before subscribe, concurrency only in package unit tests

spec_test_review.note: RV1 since #120 (apps/h5, packages/bridge-sdk, packages/ui-tokens): the rule-test review is required for RV2 only (规划/11 §2.3 step 3)
